topic: Stock Purchases and Sales: Long and Short
source_evidence: If the price of the stock rises and you buy it back later at the higher price, you will incur a loss.
question: Misconception: A short seller makes a profit if the stock price rises before they buy it back.
answer: Correction: If the stock price rises, the short seller must buy it back at a higher price and incurs a loss. A short seller hopes the price falls so they can buy it back at a lower price and make a profit.
